title: Stop Saying "Very Strong"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very strong". Use one of these words instead:
• Powerful: a powerful engine
• Sturdy: a sturdy wooden table
• Intense: an intense flavor
• Mighty (literary): a mighty river
• Fierce: a fierce wind

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
